name: MAYBANK
recent: Maybank 近期完成 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行，并推进美元债券发行与新加坡上市安排。2026 年第二季度净利小幅上升，宣布每股 31 仙股息。同期多家主要机构股东（EPF、PNB、KWAP、AmanahRaya）持续申报股权变动。
notable: 完成 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行。
发行 US$700m 双批次美元债券，并申请在新加坡上市相关债券。
2026 年第二季度业绩公布，宣布每股 31 仙股息。
risks: 多家主要机构股东近期持续申报股权变动，需留意持股结构变化。
董事局出现变动（Datuk Izham bin Ismail）。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 7,147.2m，环比增长 2.2%，同比微降 0.9%；净利为 MYR 2,690.4m，环比增长 8.5%，同比增长 2.4%；净利率为 37.6%，高于上一季度的 35.5%。

recent_en: Maybank recently completed a RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance and is progressing with US dollar bond issuance and a Singapore listing. 2Q2026 net profit rose slightly, with a 31 sen dividend declared. Several major institutional shareholders (EPF, PNB, KWAP, AmanahRaya) continued to file changes in shareholdings.
notable_en: Completed a RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance.
Raised US$700m via a dual-tranche dollar bond sale and applied for Singapore listing of the bonds.
Announced 2Q2026 results and declared a 31 sen dividend per share.
risks_en: Several major institutional shareholders have been filing changes in shareholdings; monitor changes in ownership structure.
There was a change in the boardroom (Datuk Izham bin Ismail).
earnings_en: For 2Q2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 7,147.2m, up 2.2% QoQ and down 0.9% YoY; net income was MYR 2,690.4m, up 8.5% QoQ and 2.4% YoY; net margin was 37.6%, higher than 35.5% in the previous quarter.
